comment: Pinned downloads for the Clove test fixtures. No binary file in this repository: scripts/fetch-fixtures downloads each entry into ${CLOVE_FIXTURES_DIR}/files/ and verifies bytes and sha256. See docs/fixtures.md.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Canon / EOS R6 / 3:2 / RAW / 21.84 MB / 2021-05-14
files.notes: Full RAW (not CRAW), 5472x3648, with a full-size 5472x3648 embedded JPEG preview plus 1620x1080 and 160x120 previews.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Nikon / D500 / 12bit compressed (Lossless) / Large / 18.19 MB / 2018-04-15
files.notes: 12-bit lossless compressed, large size, 5568x3712, with a full-size embedded JPEG preview plus 1620x1080 and 640x424 previews.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Sony / ILCE-7S / 14bit compressed / APS-C crop / 5.88 MB / 2017-07-13
files.notes: 14-bit compressed, APS-C crop (2768x1848). No full-size embedded preview: 1616x1080 and 160x120 only, the small-preview case for S2.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Fujifilm / X-S10 / 14bit compressed / lossless compressed / 24.62 MB / 2020-11-28
files.notes: X-Trans sensor, 14-bit lossless compressed, 6240x4160. Only small embedded previews (about 13 KB and 35 KB), so a full decode is the fallback for S2.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Olympus / E-M1MarkII / 16bit (4:3) / Standard 20MP Raw file / 16.47 MB / 2017-12-01
files.notes: Standard 20 MP raw, 5184x3888, with a 3200x2400 embedded JPEG preview (not full size) and a 160x120 thumbnail.
4:3 aspect, 4608x3456, with a 1920x1440 embedded JPEG preview and a small 35 KB thumbnail.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Pentax / K-5 II s / 14bit (3:2) / 17.68 MB / 2017-03-14
files.notes: Camera-generated DNG (DNG 1.1, not made by Adobe DNG Converter), 4928x3264, with a full-size embedded JPEG preview and a 640x480 thumbnail.

files.sourceEntry: repository row: Apple / iPhone 12 Pro / 8bit (4:3) / ljpeg predictor = 7 / 27.84 MB / 2020-12-31
files.notes: Apple ProRAW from iOS 14.3: DNG 1.4, 12-bit LinearRaw in lossy JPEG, plus an Apple semantic segmentation matte. 4032x3024, with a full-size embedded JPEG preview and 2016x1512 previews.

files.notes: Camera JPEG straight from a Canon EOS 6D: 5472x3648 (native sensor size), EXIF Make and Model present, no Software tag, so it was not re-encoded by an editor. raw.pixls.us hosts no JPEG, so this one comes from Wikimedia Commons.
